o.text:
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish كِبِی (gibi, gebi), from Proto-Turkic *kēpi, from Proto-Turkic *kēp (“form, example, image”).
cognates
Cognate with Turkish and Gagauz gibi, Turkmen kimin, Uzbek kabi, Uyghur كەبى (kebi), and Crimean Tatar kibi.
Morphologically on + -uncu. Cognate with Kazakh оныншы (onınšı), Turkish onuncu, Turkmen onunjy.
From Proto-Turkic *yara-. Cognate with Turkish yaramak, Chuvash ҫураҫ (śuraś, “to agree, consent”).

glosses: wooden pitchfork with flat teeth used to separate grain from chaff
beshbarmak (a traditional dish of nomadic Turkic peoples in Central Asia and Russia, consisting of chopped boiled meat with noodles and onion sauce.)

o.text: From Classical Persian زهر مار (“snake venom”). Cognate with Armenian զահրմար (zahrmar).
